dedupe_keys.name: stageiv irc a high resolution dataset of extreme orographic quantitative precipitation estimates qpe constrained to water budget closure for historical floods in the appalachian mountains

description: The StageIV-IRC research team publishes corrected precipitation estimates for 215 flood-producing events in 26 gauged Appalachian basins during 2008–2024. Inverse rainfall-runoff modelling adjusts the NEXRAD Stage IV analysis to meet basin water-budget closure within streamflow observation uncertainty. The repository describes 250 m fields at five-minute to hourly intervals. Zenodo lists a data ZIP, basin-information spreadsheet and readme, publicly available and free under CC-BY-4.0. Internal numerical encoding was not inspected. The correction depends on the hydrological model and discharge observations, so agreement with those same flows is not an independent validation. Selected extremes also do not constitute a continuous climatology. The fields can provide alternative rainfall forcing for flood and drainage simulations in mountainous terrain. They complement the coarser radar product with event-specific, water-budget-constrained estimates. The reading code has a separate archive and is not the dataset itself.
name: StageIV-IRC – A High-resolution Dataset of Extreme Orographic Quantitative Precipitation Estimates (QPE) Constrained to Water Budget Closure for Historical Floods in the Appalachian Mountains
